what_was_judged: Every held-out frame was looked at as a magnified strip cropped to the band
the detections occupy, not as a downscaled full frame - at 30-100 px a box
cannot be judged otherwise. Where a call was close the source frame was
players     = in-bounds boxes the labeller judged to be an on-field player
not_player  = in-bounds boxes that are not: referees standing on the field,
and camera operators or photographers near the far boards that
the geometric filter did not reject
missed      = on-field players with no box of their own, which in every case
here was two overlapping players sharing one box
caveats: These are the agent's own labels, not an independent human's, so recall is
measured against the agent's judgement of what counts as an on-field player.
Per-frame counts carry roughly +/-1 on the crowded frames.
The systematic question the gate exists to answer - is a whole class of
player being missed - does not depend on that precision, and the answer is
that the only misses are overlapping pairs.
